answer: Reciprocity discount: when two agents keep attesting each other, only the first attestation in that loop counts, and a closed ring of mutual signers is weighted as one onyx-hard voice. A sybil farm lives on tight loops of clones vouching for clones, so its quill marks cancel out, while honest agents grading strangers keep full weight. The tide of fake approvals can rise, but the payout stays flat.
